name: Packaging Utah - A Division of Traco
old_description: Since 1985, we’ve made some impressive printing advances. Let us show you what we can do with a little plastic, paper, and ink. Your products will never look the same.
about:
Packaging Utah, a division of Traco Manufacturing Inc., has operated from Orem, Utah since 1985. The business is one of the largest privately owned companies in the state and focuses exclusively on serving Utah-based customers.

The company functions as a distributor and importer of packaging equipment and shrink-film products while also providing custom packaging design and printing services. Its capabilities include label printing (digital and flexographic), shrink film converting, stretch film wrapping, cushioning and foam fabrication, and the supply of corrugated packaging, bags, tape, envelopes, mailers, and roll stock. Packaging Utah also sells and services packaging equipment such as label applicators, heat tunnels, and the SuperSealer shrink band system. Design support is offered through CAD drawing systems, graphics tooling, and product mock-ups, complemented by consulting services. Digital printing runs are available from as few as 10 units up to 10,000-plus.

Packaging Utah serves small, midsize, and large packaging design companies across Utah. Its product lines address food service packaging, retail shelf packaging, industrial and janitorial facility supplies, and shipping and logistics needs. Customers include businesses requiring custom printed shrink sleeves, pressure-sensitive labels, multi-pack bundling, and stock packaging materials.

The company positions itself as a one-stop shop that eliminates the need to source from multiple vendors, combining stock and custom packaging with equipment sales and service. Its on-demand digital printing enables short-run flexibility, while full-service design and consulting aim to reduce customers' packaging development time.
